mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN li.quantity > 0 THEN li.sku_code END) AS totalSkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.quantity - li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS availableQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reservedQuantity, 0 AS inTransitQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'DEFECTIVE' THEN li.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS damagedQuantity, COUNT(DISTINCT li.warehouse_id) AS warehouseCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' AND s.outer_length_mm IS NOT NULL AND s.outer_width_mm IS NOT NULL AND s.outer_height_mm IS NOT NULL THEN li.quantity * s.outer_length_mm * s.outer_width_mm * s.outer_height_mm / 1000000000 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalVolume, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN li.quantity > 0 AND (s.outer_length_mm IS NULL OR s.outer_width_mm IS NULL OR s.outer_height_mm IS NULL) THEN li.sku_code END) AS volumeMissingSkuCount FROM wms_location_inventory li INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = li.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.tenant_id = li.erp_tenant_id AND s.sku_code = li.sku_code WHERE li.deleted = 0

SELECT li.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, COUNT(DISTINCT li.sku_code) AS skuCount, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.quantity - li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS availableQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS reservedQuantity, 0 AS inTransitQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'DEFECTIVE' THEN li.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS damagedQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' AND s.outer_length_mm IS NOT NULL AND s.outer_width_mm IS NOT NULL AND s.outer_height_mm IS NOT NULL THEN li.quantity * s.outer_length_mm * s.outer_width_mm * s.outer_height_mm / 1000000000 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalVolume FROM wms_location_inventory li INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = li.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.tenant_id = li.erp_tenant_id AND s.sku_code = li.sku_code WHERE li.deleted = 0
GROUP BY li.warehouse_id ORDER BY w.warehouse_name, li.warehouse_id

SELECT x.sku_code AS skuCode, SUM(x.warehouse_count) AS warehouseCount, SUM(x.available_quantity) AS availableQuantity, SUM(x.reserved_quantity) AS reservedQuantity, 0 AS inTransitQuantity, SUM(x.damaged_quantity) AS damagedQuantity, SUM(x.fbo_quantity) AS fboWarehouseQuantity, SUM(x.own_quantity) AS ownWarehouseQuantity FROM ( SELECT li.sku_code, COUNT(DISTINCT li.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.quantity - li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS available_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS reserved_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'DEFECTIVE' THEN li.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS damaged_quantity, 0 AS fbo_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS own_quantity FROM wms_location_inventory li INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = li.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' WHERE li.deleted = 0
GROUP BY li.sku_code UNION ALL SELECT f.sku_code, 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(f.quantity), 0 FROM wms_fbo_inventory_snapshot f WHERE 1 = 1
AND f.tenant_id IN #{ownerId}
GROUP BY f.sku_code ) x
AND x.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY x.sku_code HAVING SUM(x.available_quantity + x.reserved_quantity + x.damaged_quantity + x.fbo_quantity) > 0 HAVING SUM(x.available_quantity + x.reserved_quantity + x.damaged_quantity + x.fbo_quantity) = 0 ORDER BY x.sku_code

SELECT li.id, li.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.region_id AS regionId, r.region_name AS regionName, li.location_id AS locationId, l.rack_no AS rackNo, l.location_code AS locationCode, z.zone_type AS zoneType, z.zone_name AS zoneName, li.sku_code AS skuCode, li.quality, li.quantity AS physicalQuantity, CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.quantity - li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END AS availableQuantity, CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END AS reservedQuantity, 0 AS inTransitQuantity, CASE WHEN li.quality = 'DEFECTIVE' THEN li.quantity ELSE 0 END AS damagedQuantity, li.update_time AS updateTime FROM wms_location_inventory li INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = li.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' INNER JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = li.location_id AND l.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_zone z ON z.id = l.zone_id AND z.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_region r ON r.id = w.region_id WHERE li.deleted = 0
AND w.region_id = #{qo.regionId} AND li.warehouse_id = #{qo.warehouseId} AND li.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.skuCode}, '%') AND l.location_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.locationCode}, '%') AND li.quality = #{qo.quality} AND li.quality = 'DEFECTIVE' AND li.quantity > 0 AND li.quantity > 0 AND li.quantity = 0 ORDER BY w.region_id, w.warehouse_name, l.rack_no, l.location_code, li.sku_code, li.quality

SELECT MIN(li.id) AS id, li.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, li.sku_code AS skuCode, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS physicalQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.quantity - li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS availableQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'GOOD' THEN li.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS reservedQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN li.quality = 'DEFECTIVE' THEN li.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS damagedQuantity, 0 AS inTransitQuantity, MAX(li.update_time) AS updateTime FROM wms_location_inventory li INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = li.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' WHERE li.deleted = 0 AND li.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND li.sku_code = #{skuCode}
GROUP BY li.warehouse_id, li.sku_code
